explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/973 (Hayman 7.3): is there C > 1 such that for every n ≥ 2 some z with z_1 = 1 and |z_i| ≥ 1 has max_{2≤k≤n+1} |Σ z_i^k| < C^{-n}? The page records no resolution, but Luo–Yang–Zhu arXiv:2607.22017 prove the maximum exceeds e^{-λn} for every λ > 0 and large n, so no such C exists; a Lean proof is linked. The statement negates the existence of C, with indices in Icc 1 n. Faithful.
